name: Lethal Ape 1
summary: Lethal Ape 1 is a circular open space sits quietly within the forest, its floor covered in soft grass that feels almost cushioned underfoot. A few scattered trees provide light shade, but most of the area is open to the sky, allowing sunlight to filter in more freely than in the dense woods beyond. The clearing has a calm, peaceful vibe, with gentle breezes rustling the leaves and birds occasionally fluttering down to perch.
